name: MEDUSA
urinary_symptoms: Marked action on lacteal glands. The secretion of milk was established after lack of it in all previous confinements.
skin_symptoms: Numbness; burning, pricking heat. Vesicular eruption especially on face, arms, shoulders, and breasts. Nettlerash (Apis; Chloral; Dulc).

source.title: MEDUSA - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
